fixture_role: Development fixture and Gate 1 acceptance corpus. Not a hidden test set. A score on this fixture is not a generalization claim.
seed_policy: Specification-fixed. The generator does not use a random number generator. Any other seed is refused so a different seed cannot label an identical corpus.
false_conflict_rate_definition: FP/(FP+TN) where the positive prediction is subtype incompatible_values and the negative class is a pair whose fixture latent values are equal.
recall_definition: TP/(TP+FN) on pairs whose fixture latent values differ.
pair_inclusion: Aligned extracted claims that share a trial and a predicate, come from different documents, and have valid-time relation overlap.
excluded_from_headline: pairs in which either assertion was not extracted

scale_rules.count_thousand: multiply the surface token by 1000 and compare as count
scale_rules.fraction: multiply the surface token by 100 and compare as percent

directional_expectation: On this fixture, numeric_rule_v0 false_conflict_rate is lower than surface_string_baseline false_conflict_rate, and numeric_rule_v0 recall is greater than or equal to baseline recall.
intentional_rule_false_positive: The fixture contains at least one latent-equal hazard_ratio pair whose absolute difference exceeds ratio_rounding_abs. A run that reports zero numeric_rule_v0 false positives is a deviation from this registration.
statistical_test: None. The fixture is a census of a fixed specification. No p-value is computed.
trained_component_seeds: Not applicable. No component is trained.
llm_only_baseline: Not run. No model endpoint is configured, the mode is open-weights only, and no weights are installed.
registered_questions: What sample size was reported for SYNTH-001?
What sample size was reported for SYNTH-005?
